responsibility: Contains the RTL expanders and instruction definitions that implement SPU builtin intrinsics after the frontend resolves them to target builtins. It lowers intrinsic calls into SPU-specific RTL for aligned loads/stores, control-word generation, constant formation, special register and channel access, interrupt-control sequences, and helper builtins like splats/extract/insert/promote, often delegating target-specific operand rewriting to C helpers in spu.c and exposing CODE_FOR_* entry points referenced from spu-builtins.def.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SPU builtins as machine-description expanders and insns, providing the RTL lowering behind CODE_FOR_* entries such as loads/stores, channel access, and splats/extract/insert/promote. Unlike spu-builtins.def, it is not the builtin inventory or signature table.
